(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg 7)
                  (line-row (let loop
                                 ((r 0))
                                 (cond
                                   ((>= r h) -1)
                                   ((for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) 4)) r)
                                   (else (loop (+ r 1))))))
                  (cells-below (for*/list ((r (range (+ line-row 1) h)) (c (range 0 w))
                                   #:when
                                   (!= (at g r c) bg))
                                 (list r c (at g r c))))
                  (below-colors (remove-duplicates (map third cells-below)))
                  (color-counts (map (lambda (col)
                                       (list col
                                             (count-if (lambda (cc) (= (third cc) col))
                                                       cells-below)))
                                     below-colors))
                  (sorted (sort color-counts (lambda (a b) (> (second a) (second b)))))
                  (main-color (first (first sorted)))
                  (main-cells (filter (lambda (cc) (= (third cc) main-color))
                                      cells-below))
                  (main-r1 (min-of first main-cells))
                  (main-r2 (max-of first main-cells))
                  (main-c1 (min-of second main-cells))
                  (main-c2 (max-of second main-cells))
                  (main-h (+ 1 (- main-r2 main-r1)))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= r line-row) 4 bg)))
                  (g-main (for/fold ((out base))
                            ((cell main-cells))
                            (set-cell out
                                      (- (first cell) main-r1)
                                      (second cell)
                                      main-color))))
             (cond
               ((< (length sorted) 2) g-main)
               (else (let* ((sec-color (first (second sorted)))
                            (sec-cells (filter (lambda (cc) (= (third cc) sec-color))
                                               cells-below))
                            (sec-r1 (min-of first sec-cells))
                            (sec-c1 (min-of second sec-cells))
                            (sec-r2 (max-of first sec-cells))
                            (sec-c2 (max-of second sec-cells))
                            (sec-h (+ 1 (- sec-r2 sec-r1)))
                            (sec-w (+ 1 (- sec-c2 sec-c1)))
                            (target-c1 (- (+ main-c1 1) sec-w))
                            (target-r1 (quotient (- main-h sec-h) 2))
                            (sec-dr (- target-r1 sec-r1))
                            (sec-dc (- target-c1 sec-c1)))
                       (for/fold ((out g-main))
                         ((cell sec-cells))
                         (let ((nr (+ (first cell) sec-dr))
                               (nc (+ (second cell) sec-dc)))
                           (cond
                             ((or (< nr 0) (>= nr h) (< nc 0) (>= nc w)) out)
                             (else (set-cell out nr nc sec-color))))))))))))
